d.ko: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!
d.en: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!
d.zh: 由虚幻4引擎打造的一款多人在线生存竞技网游，在一个超高自由度的开放世界里，可以体验采集、制造、打猎、收获、建造、研究以及驯服恐龙等超多自由内容，感受酷热白昼、冰冷夜晚的动态天气系统以及饥饿口渴等现实中的生存挑战，还要面对其它生存者的威胁，合作生存还是竞技厮杀，由你决定！
